# InteractionProcessStartConfig

An automation action (`$type` is `interaction`) that starts an interaction run. `version` names the interaction and the version of it to start, and is required.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests and responses. In a request it is called `InteractionProcessStartConfigInput`.

## In a request

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialPrompt` | `string \| null` |  | A first message to post into the run once it has started, recorded as from `System`. Optional. |
| `inputs` | [`NameValuePair`](name-value-pair.md)`[]` |  | A value for each of the interaction's inputs, by name. |
| `durationAutoTerminationOverride` | `timespan \| null` |  | Replaces the interaction's maximum run time for the runs this starts. Null: the interaction's own limit. |
| `durationWarningOverride` | `timespan \| null` |  | Replaces when the interaction's agents are warned that time is running out, for the runs this starts. Null: the interaction's own setting. |
| `swarmLimits` | [`InteractionSwarmLimitsRequestInput`](interaction-swarm-limits-request.md#in-a-request)`\| null` |  | Narrows how far the sub-interactions of each run this starts may spread, as `swarmLimits` does on an interaction start request. Null: the interaction's own limits. |
| `credentialStack` | `string \| null` |  | The credential stack (id or name) the runs this starts use, as `credentialStack` does on an interaction start request. Null: the interaction's own stack, else its namespace's default, else the tenant's. |
| `version` | [`VersionReference`](version-reference.md)`\| null` |  | The app, interaction or capsule to start, and the version of it. Required for those three; left out for `codepipeline` (named by `name`) and `interaction-message` (which names a run). |

```json
{
  "initialPrompt": "...",
  "inputs": [
    {
      "name": "...",
      "value": "..."
    }
  ],
  "durationAutoTerminationOverride": "00:05:00",
  "durationWarningOverride": "00:05:00",
  "swarmLimits": {
    "maxDepth": 0,
    "maxConcurrent": 0,
    "maxTotal": 0
  },
  "credentialStack": "...",
  "version": {
    "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
    "version": 0
  }
}
```
